_readme: Invariant register (BUILD-PLAN P1, ADR-0056). One entry per invariant in .github/copilot-instructions.md. sources: files and ADRs where the rule lives, verified by reading the code. protectedBy: existing test files with an assertion that fails if the rule breaks. coverage: full | partial | none. Every partial or none entry is listed in knownGaps, and knownGaps may only shrink (tests/harness-invariants.test.ts).

invariants.statement: The resolver fails closed: any invalid input, read failure or missing record is a refusal, never an allow.
invariants.evidence: resolveRequest refuses on invalid or missing state. Tests: 'refuses with 403 no_entitlement when the person has no entitlement record at all', 'fails closed with 503 budget_state_missing rather than granting unmetered access'.

invariants.statement: Only APIM's managed identity may call the resolver; the handler refuses when platform auth is off or no principal is present.
invariants.evidence: openGate refuses without platform auth or principal; Staged.Application.ps1 sets the Easy Auth allow-list. Tests: 'with App Service Authentication off, every request is refused 503', 'a request that reached the code without the platform principal is refused 401'.

invariants.statement: External refusal reasons are collapsed to a small set (externalCategory).
invariants.evidence: externalCategory maps reasons to temporarily_unavailable or not_authorized. Tests: 'externalCategory collapses budget-missing reasons to temporarily_unavailable', 'externalCategory collapses every other refusal reason to not_authorized'.

invariants.statement: Model admission is an exact, case-sensitive match; no prefixes, wildcards or date stripping.
invariants.evidence: The config disables prefix, date-stripping and wildcard admission. Tests: 'pure API preserves the complete policy and admits only exact registered IDs', 'actual C# rejects invalid v3 policies, admits only exact IDs'.

invariants.statement: fable and mythos require the CYB classification or restrictedFamiliesApproved: true.
invariants.evidence: Tests: 'Fable and Mythos in a group require restrictedFamiliesApproved', 'restricted families: CYB as before; the group code only with approval', 'Fable and Mythos require authoritative exact CYB even for empty or malformed entries'.

invariants.statement: No prompts, responses, tokens or credentials in logs or telemetry; sync reads IDs and account state only.
invariants.evidence: Tests: 'log events carry only reason codes and ids', 'outbound emits exactly one counts-only usage trace', 'telemetry lines carry ids, codes and counts only: no free text, names or UPNs'.

invariants.statement: Group object IDs authorize; display names are informational only.
invariants.evidence: Tests: 'a group Object ID in the project header is compared in lower case', 'classification display name is an exact optional informational snapshot, not classification authority'.

invariants.statement: All spend arithmetic uses decimal.js; no floating point.
invariants.evidence: computeSpend and the ceiling use Decimal; tests assert exact spend accumulation and Decimal rates.

invariants.statement: Exactly five token categories; an unknown category throws.
invariants.evidence: Tests: 'computeSpend refuses the undivided legacy cacheWrite category', 'the undivided legacy cacheWrite category is an unknown field, not a sixth rate'.

invariants.statement: The rate card is append-only: close an entry with effectiveTo and add a new one; never edit an entry in place.
invariants.evidence: harness-golden-ratecard compares config/rate-card.json with tests/golden/rate-card-entries.json: an entry may only be closed (effectiveTo set once, not before effectiveFrom); an edited or removed entry fails.

invariants.statement: 100 CCU = USD 1; a stored budget keeps its own currency.
invariants.evidence: CCU_PER_USD = 100; parseBudget keeps the currency. Test: '100 CCU is USD 1.00, and conversion is exact in both directions'.

invariants.statement: spent >= budget means exhausted, ceiling 0, refusal.
invariants.evidence: Tests: 'exhausted is spent >= budget: true at equality, false one smallest unit below', 'reconcilePerson clamps the ceiling to zero once spend has already reached the budget'.

invariants.statement: The reconciler writes nothing unless every read succeeded.
invariants.evidence: Tests: 'a failed ledger read writes nothing, whatever the failure', 'a failed registry read writes nothing and never queries the ledger'.

invariants.statement: A failed group read freezes that project; it is never an empty group.
invariants.evidence: Tests: 'a failed group read leaves the whole project unchanged', 'a group missing from the read results is treated as failed, never as empty'.

invariants.statement: Removals are withheld when they exceed both removal limits.
invariants.evidence: Tests: 'removalLimitExceeded: refuse only when removals exceed both the count and the fraction', 'removals over the limits are withheld, while additions and changes still apply'.

invariants.statement: A person in two classification groups keeps the incumbent, or gets neither.
invariants.evidence: Tests: 'conflict: a person in STD and PRM who already holds STD keeps STD', 'conflict: a new person in two classification groups of one project is admitted to neither'.

invariants.statement: Disabled accounts are not admitted; an unknown account state is not 'disabled'.
invariants.evidence: Tests: 'a disabled member is not admitted', 'an account state Graph did not return admits the member as before, never as disabled'.

invariants.statement: decisionVersion: 3, cache namespace ccof-ent:d3; urgent revocation = bump keyVersion.
invariants.evidence: Tests: 'v3/d3 isolates legacy decisions and validates cached allows before fresh or LKG use', 'the entitlement cache key is versioned per tenant, person and selector'.

invariants.statement: Trace sources ccof.usage.v1 / ccof.resolver.v1 and the columns of analytics/ledger.kql are contracts.
invariants.evidence: harness-golden-names pins every ccof.*.v* trace source and the output columns of analytics/ledger.kql; the policy golden pins the traces the gateway emits.

invariants.statement: Cosmos container names, partition keys and document IDs are contracts.
invariants.evidence: harness-golden-names pins every Cosmos container with its partition key and the container settings each app reads; harness-golden-bicep fails if a container's create-only id or partition key changes.

invariants.statement: Function names resolve, health, myUsage, syncEntitlement, registrySeed, snapshotApply, reconcileBudgets and their AzureWebJobs.<name>.Disabled settings never change; no hyphens.
invariants.evidence: harness-golden-names pins every registered function name (resolve, health, myUsage, syncEntitlement, registrySeed, snapshotApply, reconcileBudgets and the admin functions) and every AzureWebJobs.<name>.Disabled setting; 'OPS-01: every function name is resolved, has no hyphen, and every timer has its Disabled setting'.

invariants.statement: Timers register only in the app whose CCOF_APP_ROLE matches.
invariants.evidence: 'OPS-02: every timer is registered only inside the CCOF_APP_ROLE guard of its own app' covers the sync and reconciler guards; the sync guard is also asserted by the registry-seed and snapshot tests.

invariants.statement: Stages run 0-8 in order; a stage refuses to run before the stages it reads.
invariants.evidence: Asserts: 'Grants (Stage 3) must depend on Stage 1 and the schema (Stage 2).', 'Publishing (Stage 7) must require Entra, configuration and the verified network.'

invariants.statement: Stage 1 is create-only; its values never change for an existing resource group.
invariants.evidence: Asserts on the Stage 1 'create-only' changed-config refusal, and 'Stage outputs must not be reused after that stage config changes.'

invariants.statement: A preview changes nothing; -Apply verifies by read-back; a failed read-back records nothing.
invariants.evidence: Asserts: 'Driver must preview by default.', 'The read-back must catch a deployed account that differs', 'A create-mode rerun after a failed read-back must redeploy its own network.'

invariants.statement: An existing .staged-state/state.json keeps working; no stage turns stale without an input change.
invariants.evidence: Asserts in Test-StagedStages.ps1 ('A duration-only change must not invalidate dependent stages.'), and Test-HarnessCustomerReplay.ps1 reads the customer's state, sealed by the deployed commit, with the current driver: every stage fresh at the customer stays fresh.

invariants.statement: Ownership is by exact resource ID, never by name prefix; stages never delete.
invariants.evidence: Asserts: 'Shared Stage 1 must use exact prior operation IDs', 'Shared Stage 1 must always refuse Delete, even for a prior target.'

invariants.statement: The gateway policy is deployed only as a new non-current revision, never edited in the Portal.
invariants.evidence: Deploy-GatewayRevision.ps1 creates a new revision and makes it current only with -MakeCurrent. tests/Test-GatewayRevisionFragments.ps1 covers fragment order but not that the revision is created non-current.

invariants.statement: The client config schema and signInMethod (msal | azure-cli) stay compatible; every setup script has a restore script.
invariants.evidence: Config schema, sign-in method and setup transactions are tested. No test checks that every setup script has a restore script.

invariants.statement: Commands and parameters shown in docs exist in the scripts they name.
invariants.evidence: Reader-page tests check quoted outputs and named commands on specific pages; Test-ManualDeployment.ps1 checks manual-path parameters against templates. No general check that every documented parameter exists in its script.
